issue: लोक काष्ठ शिल ताम्र सुकर्मा — the five crafts (पंचक) of Vishwakarma's line are iron, wood, stone, copper and gold, as chaupāī 12 lists them (लोह काष्ठ अरु ताम्र सुवर्णा); लोक ('world') may be a slip for लोह ('iron'). The book and Drik Panchang both print लोक, and no independent copy was found.
our reading: लोक काष्ठ, as both witnesses print it, read as the craft of iron (लोह) beside wood, stone, copper and gold.

issue: ब्रह्मा विश्वकर्मा भय धारा — भय read as भये ('became'), not 'fear'; and whether 'Brahmā Viśvakarmā' is one name or 'you became Brahmā; (as) Viśvakarmā you bore (the work)'.
our reading: To bring about creation, your name became Brahmā Viśvakarmā, and you took it on.
alternatives: For creation you became Brahmā and bore the name Viśvakarmā.

issue: पावन चरण भवोभव कारी — भवोभव is not a dictionary word; read with the glossary as भव-उद्भव ('the origin of the world').
our reading: Your holy feet bring the world into being.
alternatives: भवाभव (existence and non-existence; MW: prosperity and adversity); भव-भव ('birth after birth').

issue: विनय करो — read as the poet's own prayer (a spelling of करौं, as in do1 विनय करौं कर जोड़कर), with तुम्हार addressing Viśvakarmā; it can also be an imperative to the reader.
our reading: I pray with both hands joined that I may hold your holy fame in my heart and keep dwelling on it, and that your grace may pour forth.
alternatives: Pray with joined hands (addressed to the reader); holding his holy fame in the heart, keep dwelling on it, and grace pours forth.
